params.1273: Climb to the top of the Wizards' Tower.
params.1274: Follow the road north out of Lumbridge until you reach the general store.
params.1275: At the general store, take the road west until you reach a bridge to the south.
params.1276: Cross the bridge and enter the tower.
params.1277: Use the ladders to climb to the top of the Wizards' Tower.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
